items.title: Hundreds arrested in France after wild Champions League celebrations
items.description: Thousands of officers tried to quell unrest as crowds of fans - some firing flares - celebrated PSG's victory over Arsenal.

items.title: Japan defence minister denies militarism and criticises China's 'huge arsenal'
items.description: Shinjiro Koizumi makes some of Tokyo's most pointed remarks yet in the dispute over Japan's military build-up.

items.title: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'deeply alarming', MSF warns
items.description: The medical charity's comments come as the head of the World Health Organization visits the region worst-hit by the virus outbreak.

items.title: 'No-one feels safe now': Residents of Romanian city hit by drone share fears
items.description: People have just begun returning to check on their homes in the block that was hit early on Friday morning.

items.title: Italy bans Kanye West and Travis Scott concerts over security concerns
items.description: Local authorities say the cancellation of other West concerts had played a role in the decision.

items.title: Oscar-winning Star Wars editor Marcia Lucas dies aged 80
items.description: The film editor and ex-wife of director George Lucas was widely recognised as a pivotal creative force behind the original space trilogy.

items.title: Ecuador accused of meddling in Colombian election with tariff vow
items.description: Ecuadorian leader Daniel Noboa offers to cancel tariffs after speaking to a right-wing presidential candidate ahead of Sunday's vote.

items.title: Four more men freed from flooded Laos cave after 10 days
items.description: Two of the seven villagers who entered the narrow tunnels in search for gold on 20 May are still missing.

items.title: US, UK and Australia to develop underwater drone technology
items.description: The technology, developed under the Aukus military pact, is aimed at protecting undersea cables and boosting naval defence.

items.title: Spain's Sánchez digs in after eight years as PM as wave of scandals threatens survival
items.description: Corruption probes of colleagues and relatives have put Spain's premier into a fight for survival.

items.title: Trump attacks artists dropping out of US Freedom 250 concert and mulls appearing himself
items.description: Performers Young MC, Poison frontman Bret Michaels and country singer Martina McBride raised concerns the event will be political.

items.title: Ghana's parliament passes anti-LGBTQ+ bill
items.description: Same-sex acts are punishable by jail terms under Ghana's new bill targeting those identifying as gay, lesbian or transgender.
